parameters.description: LinkedIn cookies. Please check https://docs.harvestapi.io/guides/custom-accounts for more details on how to get and use the cookies.

parameters.name: userAgent

parameters.name: invitationId
parameters.description: The ID of the invitation to accept.

parameters.name: sharedSecret
parameters.description: The shared secret associated with the invitation. Get it from the [received invitations endpoint](/linkedin-api-reference/interactions/received-connections).

post.description: Send LinkedIn message to the specified profile.

parameters.name: recipientProfile
parameters.description: LinkedIn profile URL to which the message will be sent. For example, 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/john-doe-123456789/'

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message text to send.

parameters.name: cookie
parameters.description: LinkedIn cookies. Please check https://docs.harvestapi.io/guides/custom-accounts for more details on how to get and use the cookies.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Proxy to use for this request. More details - https://docs.harvestapi.io/guides/custom-accounts

parameters.name: userAgent
parameters.description: User-Agent to use for this request. More details - https://docs.harvestapi.io/guides/custom-accounts

universalName.description: Universal name of the company (the last part of its URL). Null when the company was requested by ID

peopleStats.description: One entry per "People" tab group, always in this order: Locations, School, Current Function, Skill Explicit, Service categories, Field of Study. Each group holds up to 15 values sorted by count, largest first; a group without data has an empty values list

statTitle.description: Name of the group: "Locations", "School", "Current Function", "Skill Explicit", "Service categories" or "Field of Study"

title.description: Value within the group, e.g. "United States" for Locations

count.description: Number of the company employees matching the value

employeeCountRange.description: Company size as stated on its page, in the form of the `companyHeadcount` values: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000, 10001+

employeeDisplayCount.description: Employees on LinkedIn, as LinkedIn displays the number, e.g. "220K+"

highlights.description: Signals about the company: "HIRING_ON_LINKEDIN" (hiring on LinkedIn), "SENIOR_LEADERSHIP_CHANGE" (senior leadership hires in the last 90 days) or "AIQ_STRATEGIC_PRIORITIES" (one of its strategic priorities, in `label`)

type.description: Company type, e.g. "Public Company" or "Privately Held"

location.description: Headquarters location as one line, e.g. "Mountain View, California, United States"

employeeDisplayCount.description: Headcount as LinkedIn displays it, e.g. "200K+"

employeeGrowth.description: Headcount change over the last six months, year and two years

commonSearches.description: Employee counts of the common searches at the company. Counts are as LinkedIn displays them, e.g. "7.5K+"

teamLinkConnections.description: Employees connected to your team. Only for requests with a [custom account](/guides/custom-accounts)

sharedAlumni.description: Employees who studied at the same schools as you. Only for requests with a [custom account](/guides/custom-accounts)

personas.description: Employee counts per persona of your account. Only for requests with a [custom account](/guides/custom-accounts)

howTheyMakeMoney.description: AI-generated summary of the business model, with the latest yearly and quarterly revenue. Null when LinkedIn has no AI summary of the company (mostly smaller companies)

strategicPriorities.description: AI-generated strategic priorities of the company, each with its source URL. Empty when LinkedIn has no AI summary of the company

businessChallenges.description: AI-generated business challenges of the company, each with its source URL. Empty when LinkedIn has no AI summary of the company

competitiveLandscape.description: AI-generated overview of the competition. Null when LinkedIn has no AI summary of the company

headcountInsights.description: Workforce summaries and the current headcount figures

summaries.description: AI-generated observations about the headcount changes by department

executiveVoices.description: Recent LinkedIn posts of the company executives. Null when there are none

relationshipExplorer.description: People at the company suggested to reach out to. The suggestions depend on the account used for scraping

totalDisplayCount.description: Number of people found, as LinkedIn displays it

highlights.description: How many of the people found have each highlight, e.g. "RPC" (recently changed jobs) or "RPOL" (posted on LinkedIn). "PCOLL" (your past colleagues) and "COMM" (shared experiences with you): only for requests with a [custom account](/guides/custom-accounts)

companyHighlights.description: Highlights of the company itself, e.g. "HIRING_ON_LINKEDIN" or "SENIOR_LEADERSHIP_CHANGE"

leads.description: Up to 8 of the people found

growthInsights.description: Headcount, hiring and job opening charts

changePercentage.description: Headcount change over the whole series (two years), in percent

monthly.description: Headcount month by month over the last two years

headcountByFunction.description: Headcount by job function. `total` is the company total over the last year

threeMonths.description: Headcount by function over the last three months

sixMonths.description: Headcount by function over the last six months

oneYear.description: Headcount by function over the last year

newHires.description: New hires month by month over the last two years

jobOpenings.description: Job openings and their change over time, in total and by function

recentGrowthAlerts.description: Up to 3 latest alerts about the company growth or risks, e.g. employees of another company moving here

peopleAlsoViewed.description: Similar companies that people also viewed, up to 12

accountAlerts.description: Latest alerts about the company and its employees: company posts, job changes, etc.

nextStart.description: Offset of the next page of alerts; null when there are no more

AccountInsightsMoney.description: An amount of money: `amount` of `unit`, e.g. 402.84 BILLION USD

percentage.description: Headcount change over the timespan, in percent

AccountInsightsRevenue.description: Revenue of a period: the reported figure and the estimated range

period.description: "2025" for a year, "Q2 2026" for a quarter

degree.description: Connection degree between the person and your account: 1, 2 or 3, and -1 when out of network. Only for requests with a [custom account](/guides/custom-accounts)

id.description: e.g. "HIRING_ON_LINKEDIN" or "SENIOR_LEADERSHIP_CHANGE" for a company, "RECENTLY_HIRED" or "POSTED_ON_LINKEDIN" for a person

degree.description: Connection degree between the person and your account: 1, 2 or 3, and -1 when out of network. Only for requests with a [custom account](/guides/custom-accounts)

lead.description: The person the alert is about, for alerts about employees

changePercentage.description: Change against the previous month, in percent
Change over the period, in percent

latestCount.description: Job openings in the latest quarter

threeMonthPercentage.description: Change over three months, in percent

sixMonthPercentage.description: Change over six months, in percent

oneYearPercentage.description: Change over one year, in percent

id.description: The unique identifier for the reaction.

postId.description: The ID of the post that was reacted to.

id.description: The unique identifier for the actor.

linkedinUrl.description: The LinkedIn profile URL of the actor.

position.description: The current position of the actor.
position.example: Student at Yashwantrao Mohite College of Arts, Science and Commerce, Pune

pictureUrl.description: The URL of the actor's profile picture.

width.description: The width of the picture in pixels.

height.description: The height of the picture in pixels.

expiresAt.description: The expiration timestamp of the picture URL in milliseconds since epoch.

id.description: The unique identifier for the comment.

linkedinUrl.description: The direct URL to the comment on LinkedIn.

commentary.description: The text content of the comment.

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was created.

numComments.description: The number of replies to this comment.

numShares.description: The number of times this comment has been shared (often null for comments).

numImpressions.description: The number of impressions for this comment (often null).

reactionTypeCounts.description: A list of reaction types and their counts for this comment.

count.description: The number of this type of reaction.

postId.description: The ID of the post to which this comment belongs.

id.description: The unique identifier for the actor who made the comment.

linkedinUrl.description: The LinkedIn profile URL of the actor.

position.description: The current position or headline of the actor.
position.example: Business Analyst | Data-Driven Decision Maker | 5+ Years of Experience in Municipal Data Systems & Public Sector Projects | Passionate About Driving Innovation in Local Governance | Always Exploring New Technologies

pictureUrl.description: The URL of the actor's profile picture.

width.description: The width of the picture in pixels.

height.description: The height of the picture in pixels.

expiresAt.description: The expiration timestamp of the picture URL in milliseconds since epoch.

author.description: Indicates if the actor is the original author of the parent post.

createdAtTimestamp.description: The timestamp of when the comment was created, in milliseconds since epoch.

pinned.description: Indicates if the comment is pinned.

contributed.description: Indicates if the actor is a contributor to the content (e.g., a group admin or page role).

edited.description: Indicates if the comment has been edited.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LinkedIn group.

memberCount.description: Number of members in the group.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the logo URL expires.

url.description: URL of the group's hero image.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the hero image URL expires.

heroImage.description: Details about the group's hero image.

date.description: Creation date of the group in string format.

timestamp.description: Creation date of the group as a Unix timestamp.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp and date of the group.

groupPlusStatusActive.description: Indicates if Group Plus status is active.

postApprovalEnabled.description: Indicates if post approval is enabled for the group.

invitationLevel.description: Level of invitation required for the group (e.g., 'Anyone', 'ByInvitation').

automatedWelcomeNoteEnabled.description: Indicates if automated welcome note is enabled.

publicVisibility.description: Indicates if the group is publicly visible.

text.description: Text representation of administrators (e.g., "John Doe and 2 others").

id.description: Unique identifier for the admin profile.

linkedinUrl.description: URL of the admin's LinkedIn profile.

headline.description: Headline of the admin's LinkedIn profile.

picture.description: URL of the admin's profile picture.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LinkedIn group.

members.description: Text representation of the member count (e.g., '10,000+ members').

summary.description: Short summary or description of the group.

picture.description: URL of the group's profile picture.

value.description: Value associated with the action (e.g., a URL or action ID).

primaryActions.description: List of primary actions related to the group.
